details:
I, and many people I've talked about the idea with, have expressed a lot of interest ever since first playing VRC in having more fine controls over your friends list. There's a few options that I see as being really obvious, very simple fixes for these issues. Most of us have had a friend who spams requests or doesn't respect boundaries, but you don't want to unfriend them because you still consider them a friend.

As VRC sits currently, your options are: going on red and no one can contact you at all without an invite, or sitting there and taking spam/constant joining from someone.

A few ways that would seem to easily fix this:

2-tiered friends list, where you have standard friends/people leaning more acquaintance, and then a closer friends list, where you could allow certain trusted friends to request even if on DND, or who can join when you're on "ask me" without having to request first. 

A friend "snooze" option, where you could hide invites/requests and your location from certain people on your friends list either indefinitely or for a set amount of time. 

An option to simply hide the invite/request popup from your HUD, but allow it to still go to your inbox, would also work. It's rather basic and might cause other issues, though. Could set it so that only favorited friends pop up a HUD icon.

In any case, the common thread is having more fine control over invites/requests/joins without having to overhaul how statuses or the invite system work.
title: More granular friends list controls re: invites & joinability
